data.long_meaning: The name Falgunika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Falguni', which refers to a red-colored goddess. The name signifies the one who is the daughter of this goddess. In Hindu mythology, Falguni is associated with love, fertility, and prosperity.

historical_references.reference: Falguni is a Sanskrit name of Hindu origin that has been popular in Nepal and northern India. It is derived from the word ' Falgun ' which means 'bright' or 'radiant'. Falgun is the name of the month of February in the Hindu calendar.

historical_references.reference: The name Falguni is also associated with the Hindu deity, Falgun Devi. She is the goddess of spring, love, passion and fertility. Her worship is particularly popular in the western Indian states of Gujarat and Maharashtra.
historical_references.context: Hindu religious traditions in western India
